idle.title: Update Simeon's Computer?
idle.description: This updates the shared computer all your agents run on to the latest version. Their files and logins are kept.

one.title: An agent is working
one.description: Nora is working right now. Waiting lets its current turn finish. Updating now recreates the computer and interrupts it. Files and logins are kept either way.

oneBlank.title: An agent is working
oneBlank.description: An agent is working right now. Waiting lets its current turn finish. Updating now recreates the computer and interrupts it. Files and logins are kept either way.

two.title: Update while agents are working?
two.description: Nora and Ben are working on Simeon's computer right now. Updating recreates the computer and interrupts their current turns. Files and logins are kept.
